baseline.method: OLS on controls whose labels matured before each UTC day (out-of-sample); added value = test minus reference residuals
baseline.severity_feature: features.severity (event-group references: medians must be within 25%)

comparison.rationale: alt shocks hypothesised to propagate to BTC; oriented with the alt move

exclusions: windows with missing bars in any of the three assets
question: After an ETH/SOL 5-minute shock with BTC calm, does BTC follow the alt more than scheduled entries do?
status_note: 100 retained non-overlapping observations in >= 20 dependence blocks is house governance (operating document), not a statistical test; promotion rules in lab/experiments.py
